whatis.h2: What is a warehouse space requirement?
whatis.intro: A warehouse space requirement is the floor area your stock needs at its busiest, with room for people and pallet jacks to move. You get it from cases, pallets and stack height, then add aisles, dock and staging. It is the figure a lease should be sized on.

cards.title: What it measures
cards.body: The floor your stock needs, not what a building holds. Start from 3,000 cases at peak and it works forward to 725 sq ft.
cards.alt: Open book, for the floor your peak stock needs

cards.title: Rooms it does not count
cards.body: Offices, restrooms, a returns cage and forklift charging. The aisle share covers aisles, dock and staging only, so add the rest on top.
cards.alt: Minus sign, for the rooms the estimate does not include

cards.title: Staging grows with routes
cards.body: The calculator folds staging into the 45%. For a distributor, it tracks how many trucks you load at once, not how much stock you hold.
cards.alt: Light bulb, for staging space sized by the trucks you load

look.h2: Keep the square footage estimate honest
look.intro: Every result on the page comes from the first few inputs. These three are where a space estimate tends to drift.

steps.title: One real peak, not a sum of peaks
steps.body: In shared storage, adding each line's busiest week overstates it, because lines do not all peak together. Use the most cases you held on one actual day.

steps.title: Stack height the product can bear
steps.body: Not every case can carry a pallet on top. Soft or fragile lines often stay one high, so run them on their own before you enter 2.

steps.title: Each temperature zone on its own
steps.body: Run dry, cooler and freezer as three separate estimates. One blended run lets spare dry floor hide a freezer that is already full.

vos.h2: Where VOS sits next to your warehouse
vos.h3: Sizing the building stays with you
vos.body: VOS does not size buildings or run a warehouse: no bins, pick paths or scanning. It works on the orders coming in. Customers order by voice in the VOS app at any hour, so overnight orders are waiting when the day's picking is planned.
